summaryUpdate: Backend for an AI-Driven Crop Health Monitor application using Node.js/Express/MongoDB with JWT auth, image upload + AI classification placeholder, advisory engine, diagnosis history, i18n (EN/HI), and SMS fallback (Twilio placeholder), built with MVC structure and production middleware (rate limiting, CORS, Helmet, logging).

new_feature_requests_to_add.summary: Implement user authentication (register/login) with JWT-protected routes and User schema (name, phone, email, hashed password, preferredLanguage, location).

Create image upload + diagnosis endpoint POST /api/diagnose using Multer and Cloudinary/local storage, call mock/external AI classifyImage placeholder, store diagnosis in MongoDB, and return diagnosis response payload.
Implement advisory engine using static advisory library JSON keyed by issueType + riskLevel, returning advisory + next 3 days checklist (with translations).
Add history endpoint GET /api/history to return logged-in user’s past diagnoses sorted by latest.
Implement multi-language support via i18n with English + Hindi locales and translated advisory messages.
Implement SMS low-bandwidth fallback POST /api/sms/diagnose: parse SMS format, call mock classification, and send SMS reply via Twilio integration placeholder using env vars.
Set up production-ready Express app structure: MVC folder layout, centralized error handler, input validation (express-validator), RESTful routes, async/await patterns.
Add security/ops middleware and tooling: rate limiting, CORS, Helmet, Morgan logging, dotenv config, .env.example, and Axios integration placeholder for external AI APIs.

architecturalNotesToAdd: Do not implement any local ML/CNN model; use mock/external AI classifyImage(imageUrl, cropType) placeholder via Axios.
Use Node.js + Express with MongoDB (Mongoose) and an MVC folder structure (config/controllers/routes/models/services/middlewares/utils/locales).
Auth via JWT with password hashing; protect relevant routes.
Images uploaded via Multer and stored via Cloudinary or local filesystem abstraction.
Use i18n with at least English and Hindi; advisory/checklist messages must be translatable.
Include centralized error-handling middleware and request validation using express-validator.
Include production middleware: rate limiting, CORS, Helmet, Morgan; configuration via dotenv and provide .env.example.
Twilio SMS integration is a placeholder driven by environment variables; parse inbound SMS format and reply with risk + short advice.
